summary_1line: Monkey chiefs declare how far they can leap across the ocean while Angada and Jambavan assess their limits and leadership duties.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada stands before a vast assembly of monkeys on the seashore as the chiefs step forward one by one to proclaim how many miles they can leap.
The aged bear-king Jambavan, bowing respectfully, speaks of his past glory while the gathered monkeys listen in solemn silence.
Young Angada gazes over the roaring ocean, admitting he can leap across but is uncertain if he can return.
